verdicts.justification: The proposed fix addresses an issue where the `_emoji_replace` function runs emoji replacement on text parts that have no colon, which does not affect the text content. The fix improves the performance of `console.print` by reducing unnecessary emoji replacements. The proposed changes are based on the provided code snippet and the observed performance improvements.
verdicts.draft_response: Fix for #4272: The fix only runs emoji replacement when the text has a colon, improving performance by about 1%. No changes to the text content are affected. The fix is proposed and no further action is needed.
verdicts.title: console.print runs the emoji replacement on text that has no colon
